_comment: The model viewer's models (#/models). Paths are from the repository's root; the build copies the files into the site. See docs/recipe-browser/models.md.

models.title: Bucking sawmill
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's bucking sawmill: two drag saws on a shared crankshaft, lowered and wound back up by a windlass, that cross-cut trunks into logs. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/BuckingSawmill/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Most of this model was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. Its gears, saw blades, saw heads and cranks are from Immersive Woodworking's sawmill model by Bobrik00, used with permission; those parts are not covered by the repository's license.

depth.label: Saw depth
depth.hint: 0 is the top of the cycle, 1 is through the trunk at the bed

models.title: Rosser
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's rosser: a ring debarker that draws a Logging Expanded trunk lengthwise through a spinning cutter ring, whose spring-closed scraper arms ride the trunk and strip its bark. Geared feed rolls run at one speed for thin trunks and a slower one for thick, changed by the same weight that lowers the cradles. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Rosser/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Most of this model was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. Its crown disc and rectifier pinions, and the tooth its other gears are built from, are from Immersive Woodworking's sawmill model by Bobrik00; those parts belong to Bobrik00 and are not covered by the repository's license.

reverse.label: Axle turns backwards
reverse.hint: The rectifier turns everything past it the same way

trunk.label: Trunk travel
trunk.hint: 0 is waiting on the infeed bed; the end is delivered on the outfeed bed

presence.label: Trunk presence
presence.hint: Eases in as a trunk is loaded and out as it is taken away

requires.ring: Cutter ring and arms (large gear sections)
requires.levers: Treadle, rock shaft and selector levers (sawmill feed levers)

models.title: Gear cutter
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's gear cutter, two blocks by two by two: a temporal gear master on the arbor rolls on a fixed rack while a rack-tooth cutter generates the same teeth in a steel blank beside it, and a Jonas planetary head indexes the arbor one tooth per pass. One master station takes the temporal gear (12 teeth, the size of the game's gears) or the large temporal gear (20). The feed's rectifier, clutch, worm and wheel are enclosed in the column and a gearbox with removable covers; a sight-feed drip oiler over the cutter shows the machine's oil. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/GearCutter/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used. The masters wear the game's temporal gear texture.

theta.label: Axle angle
theta.hint: Turns the cone pulleys, the head shaft and the cutter

reverse.label: Axle turns backwards
reverse.hint: The feed's rectifier turns the camshaft forward either way

work.label: Teeth cut
work.hint: One unit is one tooth's whole cycle: the knee rises, the table runs the pass and back, the knee drops and the head indexes. Twelve axle turns a tooth; the cut ends at 12 teeth or 20.

size.label: Master fitted
size.hint: It sets the knee's height, the shield on the index and the gear cut

presence.label: Master presence
presence.hint: Eases in as a master is fitted and out as it is taken off

oil.label: Oil tank
oil.hint: How full the machine's oil tank is: the sight-feed cup's level

models.title: Draw bench
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's draw bench, one block wide and four long: a chain draw bench that draws a lead or copper hollow section (the game's chute section), threaded on a mandrel, through a die into four pipe sections, a quarter of it a stroke. The dog grips each section's point at the die and an endless chain beside the bed, shackled to it, hauls it along, driven from the axle through a rectifier, a cone clutch and a two-speed change gear (copper draws at half lead's speed). Each section is handed out as its draw finishes and the jaws open, the dog knocks the clutch out at the end of its stroke, and a counterweight hauls the chain and the dog back. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/DrawBench/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

theta.label: Axle angle
theta.hint: Turns the entry shaft and the rectifier's gears

reverse.label: Axle turns backwards
reverse.hint: The rectifier turns the clutch's cup the same way either way

work.label: Sections drawn
work.hint: One unit is one stroke's whole cycle: the start lever throws the clutch in and shuts the jaws, the dog draws the section, the jaws open and the section is handed out (it leaves the model), the dog knocks the clutch out, the weight hauls the dog back, and the bench waits for the next. Four sections a hollow.

size.label: Hollow section on the bench
size.hint: Copper slides the change gear to its slow pair

presence.label: Hollow presence
presence.hint: Eases in as a hollow section is loaded and out as the bench is cleared

oil.label: Oil tank
oil.hint: How full the machine's oil tank is: the oiler's level

requires.gearbox: Gearbox: cone clutch and change gears (Jonas gearbox)
requires.dog: Dog: carriage and drawing tongs (heavy bracket)
requires.billetlead: Lead hollow section and its pipe sections
requires.billetcopper: Copper hollow section and its pipe sections

models.title: Squaring shear
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's squaring shear, one block wide and two long: a tinsmith's foot-treadle squaring shear of the early 1800s in oak with iron blades. A lead or copper plate lies on the table against the back gauge, the hold-down comes down on it, the treadle pulls the crosshead and its blade down through it across its middle, and the two half plates are drawn off towards the operator under the raised blade. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/SquaringShear/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

theta.label: Treadle worked
theta.hint: The player holds right-click on the shear to work it; this is that clock. The model is posed by the cut cycle below, which Play moves with it (one stroke a lead plate; one and a half in the game for copper)

reverse.label: Work backwards
reverse.hint: Play's clock runs either way; the cycle only goes forward

work.label: Cut cycle
work.hint: One plate: the hold-down comes down, the treadle brings the blade down through the plate and lets it back up, the hold-down rises and the two half plates are drawn onto the table at 1.

size.label: Plate on the shear
size.hint: Lead and copper are cut alike; copper takes half as long again

presence.label: Plate presence
presence.hint: Eases in as a plate goes on (the hold-down rises off the table) and out after the half plates are taken

requires.platelead: Lead plate and its half plates
requires.platecopper: Copper plate and its half plates

models.title: Press brake
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's press brake, one block wide and two long: a hand-worked leaf brake (cornice brake) of the early 1800s in oak with iron wearing edges and cupronickel screws. A lead or copper half plate, cut on the squaring shear, lies across the folding edge, half on the bed and half over the leaf; its near half is clamped under a bar brought down by two screws and the leaf folds the other half up once, across its middle, into an angle with two 4-wide legs, over-bent for its spring-back, then the angle is slid off onto the leaf. Copper is screwed down harder and the leaf thrown further. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/PressBrake/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

theta.label: Lever worked
theta.hint: The player holds right-click on the brake to work it; this is that clock. The model is posed by the fold cycle below, which Play moves with it (one and a half turns a lead half plate; two and a quarter in the game for copper)

reverse.label: Work backwards
reverse.hint: Play's clock runs either way; the cycle only goes forward

work.label: Fold cycle
work.hint: One half plate: the bar comes down on the half on the bed, the leaf folds the half over it up and drops back, the bar goes up and the angle slides onto the leaf at 1.

size.label: Half plate on the brake
size.hint: Copper is screwed down a quarter turn harder and the leaf thrown to 100 degrees against lead's 95

presence.label: Half plate presence
presence.hint: Eases in as a half plate goes on (the bar rises off the bed) and out after the angle is taken

requires.platelead: Lead half plate and its angle
requires.platecopper: Copper half plate and its angle

models.title: Mandrel forging station
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's mandrel forging station, one block wide and two long: a smith's station of the 1700s, an oak stump carrying an iron mandrel in a bracket, with a small swage beside it. A lead or copper hollow section is hammered down onto the mandrel blow by blow: the metal is drawn out towards the tip and the box closes from 8 to 6 across behind it, root half then tip half, into one tube that is parted into two pipe sections, which slide off the tip and drop beyond it. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/MandrelStation/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used.

theta.label: Hammer blows
theta.hint: The player's right-clicks with a hammer, one turn a blow; this is that clock. The model is posed by the forging below, which Play moves with it (nine blows a lead hollow; fourteen for copper in the game)

reverse.label: Count backwards
reverse.hint: Play's clock runs either way; the forging only goes forward

work.label: Forging
work.hint: One hollow: the metal is drawn out towards the tip, the root half of the box closes from 8 to 6 across onto the mandrel, the metal is drawn out again and the tip half closes; the tube is parted, and the two pipe sections slide off the tip and drop, delivered at 1.

size.label: Hollow on the mandrel
size.hint: Copper takes half as many blows again; the model moves the same

presence.label: Hollow presence
presence.hint: Eases in as a hollow goes on; in the game the work is no longer drawn once its sections are delivered

requires.hollowlead: Lead hollow and its two sections
requires.hollowcopper: Copper hollow and its two sections

models.title: Handcar
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's handcar, a standard-gauge rail car for Yang's Transport Tycoon pumped by two riders: a walking beam on an A-frame rocks on its pivot, and its pitman turns a crank on a countershaft whose 24-tooth gear drives an 8-tooth pinion on the front axle, three turns of the wheels a stroke. The marked points are where the riders stand and hold the handles, and where a chest or crate goes. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Handcar/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: Made for the Seraph Horizons mod; no other mod's model is used. It wears the game's oak and copper textures.

theta.label: Axle angle
theta.hint: The wheels turn by it, the countershaft and crank a third as fast; the pitman rocks the beam.

models.title: Eidolon
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's laborer eidolon: the game's unused mobile eidolon body at the boss's size (3.75 blocks tall), restyled in tarnished brass, with the laborer's own animations: felling with a two-handed axe, lifting and carrying blocks and trunks, standing guard, hanging in its gantry and waking, slumping at 0 HP and standing up again. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Eidolon/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: The body is Anego Studios' model, Vintage Story's mobile eidolon (game 1.22.7), with its vanilla animations; it is not covered by the repository's license. The anchors, attachment points and the laborer's animations were made for the Seraph Horizons mod.

labels.trunk-carry-idle: Standing with a trunk on the shoulder
labels.trunk-carry-walk: Walking with a trunk on the shoulder
labels.hung: Hung in the gantry (clamped by the back to the gantry's spine, which is not drawn here)
labels.activate: First awakening: unclamps from the spine and steps off it

models.title: Eidolon gantry
models.description: The Seraph Horizons mod's eidolon gantry, six blocks deep, five wide and five and a half high: an open oak frame with iron plates, brackets and pegs in which the eidolon is built stage by stage, hung limp from a hand winch at the back whose chain runs over a sheave on the hoist beam and whose crank is outside the frame, on the south side; it stays as the eidolon's dock, and the front (west) is open for it to walk out of. The chain hangs a wooden spine by a ring over its top peg, the gantry's own, there before anything is fitted; the torso is clamped onto it first and the rest built on, and when the eidolon wakes it unclamps, steps forward off it and leaves it hanging empty. Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/EidolonGantry/tools/make_shape.py.
models.credit: The gantry, its winch and chains were made for the Seraph Horizons mod. The body hung in it and the spine it hangs from are Anego Studios' model, Vintage Story's mobile eidolon, posed in its hung animation; they are not covered by the repository's license.

theta.label: Crank worked
theta.hint: The player turning the winch's crank, outside the frame on the south side; this is that clock. The model is posed by the let-down below, which Play runs with it: the crank turns a two-stage spur train (10 to 50 teeth, twice: 25 to 1) to the drum, about three turns over the let-down, and the pawl is thrown off its ratchet as it starts

reverse.label: Crank backwards
reverse.hint: Play's clock runs either way; the let-down runs down, waits and winds back up

depth.label: Let down
depth.hint: 0 is hung, the lowest toe 3 voxels off the floor; 1 is let down onto the floor. The spine comes down with the body. The eidolon wakes from 0: it unclamps from the spine and drops onto its feet

requires.torso: Stage 2: torso, clamped to the spine (with no stage ticked: the empty spine, as built, or as the eidolon leaves it when it wakes)
requires.head: Stage 6: head
